details.description: gpt-transcribe is OpenAI's speech-to-text model for transcribing completed audio files through the Transcription endpoint. OpenAI positions it as the current recommended model for general file transcription, ahead of the older whisper-1 model, which OpenAI now reserves for cases needing word-level timestamps, translation, or subtitle generation. It accepts optional prompt, keyword, and language-hint parameters to improve accuracy on domain-specific terms, multilingual audio, and code-switching, and can stream back partial transcript text as a file is processed. It does not perform speaker diarization; OpenAI directs that need to a separate gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize model.
advantages: OpenAI documents it as the current recommended default for general file-based transcription, ahead of the legacy whisper-1 model.
Accepts prompt, keywords, and languages parameters to improve accuracy on domain-specific terminology and multilingual or code-switched audio.
Supports streamed output during transcription, emitting incremental transcript.text.delta events followed by a final transcript.text.done event.
disadvantages: Does not support speaker diarization; OpenAI directs that use case to the separate gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize model.
Limited to completed audio files up to 25 MB per request.
use_cases: Transcribing a completed recording or bounded audio file via the Transcription API
Producing a streamed transcript as an audio file is being processed
Improving accuracy on domain-specific terms or multilingual, code-switched audio using keyword and language hints

sources.title: Speech to text - OpenAI API guide

notes: OpenAI's own model page lists a Realtime Transcription endpoint (v1/realtime/transcription_sessions) alongside file transcription, but Microsoft's Azure OpenAI models page states gpt-transcribe 'is an offline transcription model and isn't a Realtime API model,' directing streaming/realtime use to gpt-realtime-whisper or gpt-live-transcribe instead; description here follows the catalog's facts (file-transcription endpoint only) and omits the disputed realtime claim. No WER or other accuracy benchmark for this exact model was found on a maker or credible evaluator page.
